lines.text: After Nahash's son Hanun became king, he shaved off half of each beard of David's servants and cut their garments at the hips.
David told his humiliated servants to stay in Hebron until their beards had grown back.
The Ammonites hired Aramean soldiers, so David sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men.
Joab arrayed the best men against the Arameans and put his brother Asahel over the rest against the Ammonites.
David crossed the Jordan to Helam, where the Arameans fled, and he struck down their commander Shobach.
